passage:
Hi Chef Aris,

I'm reaching out because I had the pleasure of dining at The Velvet Lounge last night for my 10th wedding anniversary. My wife and I have been fans of your culinary work for years, and we were very excited to try the new "Seasonal Tasting Menu" we've heard so much about.

While the flavors of the food were absolutely world-class—the pan-seared scallops with truffle foam were a particular highlight—I'm sorry to say that the service and the pacing of the evening didn't live up to the standard of a Michelin-starred establishment. We were seated promptly at 7:30 PM, but it took nearly 25 minutes before a server arrived to take our drink order. For a tasting menu that is supposed to be a choreographed experience, we found ourselves sitting with empty glasses and used plates for long stretches of time.

Furthermore, we had specifically mentioned a severe strawberry allergy for my wife when we made the reservation two weeks ago. When the dessert course arrived, it was a "Summer Berry Tart" that clearly contained fresh strawberries. When we pointed this out to our waiter, he seemed confused and had to check with the kitchen. He did eventually bring a replacement, but the error was quite concerning given the high stakes of a food allergy.

We spent over $500 on the evening, and while we are happy to pay for quality, the lack of attention to detail made the experience feel somewhat stressful rather than celebratory. I've always recommended your restaurant to my business associates, but after last night, I'm hesitant to do so.

I'm not looking for a full refund, but I felt you should know about these lapses so they can be addressed with your front-of-house team. I would love to return in the future and see the restaurant back at its usual level of excellence.

Best regards,
David Miller
